The query joins tract boundaries with EPA facility counts, PLACES population and adult asthma prevalence, computes facilities per 1,000 residents, filters to tracts with both measures, and returns the correlation and paired tract count alongside each tract ranked by facility rate.
sql:
WITH facility AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS facility_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261027_8dd81a' AND source = 'm1_cdc' AND grp = 'all'
),
pop AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_8dd81a_m3_cdc
),
asthma AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_prevalence_pct
  FROM session.fw_8dd81a_m2_cdc
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.geoid,
         t.name,
         COALESCE(f.facility_count, 0) AS facility_count,
         p.totalpopulation,
         a.adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
         CASE WHEN p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0
              THEN COALESCE(f.facility_count, 0) / p.totalpopulation * 1000
              ELSE NULL END AS epa_facilities_per_1000_residents
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN facility f ON t.geoid = f.geoid
  LEFT JOIN pop p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
  LEFT JOIN asthma a ON t.geoid = a.geoid
)
SELECT name,
       epa_facilities_per_1000_residents,
       adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
       totalpopulation,
       facility_count,
       CORR(epa_facilities_per_1000_residents, adult_asthma_prevalence_pct) OVER () AS correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM base
WHERE epa_facilities_per_1000_residents IS NOT NULL
  AND adult_asthma_prevalence_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY epa_facilities_per_1000_residents DESC, name
LIMIT 200
